hook.text: Dry one year, sweet the next. Why?
hook.answer: The style depends on the year: sec, demi-sec or moelleux, with sweet wines made in the warmest vintages; the area is at the climatic limit for Chenin Blanc.
hook.source: Open Wine Atlas study.json lesson north-france-loire-centre (Vouvray and Montlouis); INAO cahier des charges X.3 (limite climatique du chenin B)

facts.claim: AOC Vouvray recognised in 1936 (décret du 8 décembre 1936)
facts.source: INAO, cahier des charges AOC Vouvray (version with the modification adopted by the Comité national on 18 June 2026), sections I and X.1°b

facts.claim: North bank of the Loire, just east of Tours; Chenin Blanc
facts.source: Open Wine Atlas study lesson north-france-loire-centre; atlas_note
Open Wine Atlas details-fr.json area_ha (INAO data, 2026-08-31)

facts.claim: 8 communes including Tours: Chançay, Noizay, Parçay-Meslay, Reugny, Rochecorbon, Tours, Vernou-sur-Brenne, Vouvray (plus part of Nazelles-Négron per the 2026 modification)
facts.source: INAO, cahier des charges AOC Vouvray (version with the modification adopted by the Comité national on 18 June 2026) IV.1°; Open Wine Atlas communes list

facts.claim: Tuffeau du Turonien (soft chalk) under clay-silica elements and loess; tuffeau cliffs with caves used for winemaking and storage
facts.source: INAO, cahier des charges AOC Vouvray (version with the modification adopted by the Comité national on 18 June 2026) X.1°a and X.1°b; study lesson 'tuffeau covered with clay and flint'

facts.claim: Plateau at 85 to 110 m cut by dry valleys, ending in a cliff over the Loire valley
facts.source: INAO, cahier des charges AOC Vouvray (version with the modification adopted by the Comité national on 18 June 2026) X.1°a

facts.claim: Atlas terrain of the outline: min 52, mean 100, max 120 m
Tours 677.8 mm a year, 1991-2020; specification says about 680 mm
Mean temperature April to October at Tours 16.24 °C (shown 16.2)
October daily low to high 9.0 to 17.0 °C at Tours
The area is at the climatic limit for Chenin B
facts.source: INAO, cahier des charges AOC Vouvray (version with the modification adopted by the Comité national on 18 June 2026) X.3

facts.claim: Main variety Chenin B; accessory Orbois B at most 5% of the vines, so Chenin at least 95%
facts.source: INAO, cahier des charges AOC Vouvray (version with the modification adopted by the Comité national on 18 June 2026) V.1°a and V.2°

facts.claim: Style depends on the year: sec, demi-sec or moelleux; sweet wines in the warmest vintages; much Vouvray is sparkling
facts.source: Open Wine Atlas study lesson north-france-loire-centre

facts.claim: Sparkling wines by second fermentation in bottle; at least 12 months of ageing from tirage before marketing
facts.source: INAO, cahier des charges AOC Vouvray (version with the modification adopted by the Comité national on 18 June 2026) IX.2°b and IX.5°a
